content.title: Yugen Golf City — 5-star golf resort living next to Mopa airport
content.subtitle: North Goa region's first golf-centric township: plots, lake-facing villas, golf farmhouses and apartments beside Mopa airport
content.description: Yugen Golf City is a proposed 500+ acre golf-centric township by Yugen Infra, next to Manohar International Airport (Mopa) and on the NH-66 Goa–Mumbai highway. It is planned around a 9-hole executive golf course designed by IDG (UK), and the township is to be managed by a five-star hospitality partner. It is being sold in parts: Garden of Eden villa plots (RERA-approved, 278 plots on 45 acres), Acqua Front lake-facing villas run with The Registry Collection by Wyndham, Golf Drive farmhouses, studio to 2 BHK apartments, and an invitation-only Cricket Front Villas enclave. Phase I, Golfer's Paradise, had 151 villa plots on 30 acres, which the developer reports as sold out.
content.overview:
Yugen Golf City is being developed by Yugen Infra, whose delivered projects include Sohna Greens (11 acres, DDJAY, Sector 4 Sohna, Gurugram), La Mandre (13 villas at Mandrem Beach, Goa) and a 250-acre industrial township at Sonipat.

The developer's case rests on three things:
• Location beside the new Mopa airport and NH-66, with the proposed Shakti Peeth Expressway alongside
• A golf course and resort-style amenities run by a five-star hospitality brand
• Hotel-managed villas with a stated rental commitment

faqs.question: Where exactly is Yugen Golf City?
faqs.answer: The developer's map and plan sheets place it at Banda, beside NH-66 and about 5 km (aerial) north of Manohar International Airport, Mopa. Banda lies just across the Goa border in Sindhudurg district, Maharashtra, although the project is marketed as Goa. Confirm the state, village and survey numbers in the sale documents.

faqs.question: Is the project RERA registered?
faqs.answer: The Garden of Eden villa plots carry RERA number PP1310002501906 in the developer's material. Check that number on the relevant state RERA portal; its format suggests MahaRERA. Each other phase (villas, farmhouses, apartments) needs its own registration, so ask for the number of the exact phase you buy.

faqs.question: What can I buy and at what price?
faqs.answer: Per the developer's poster: Garden of Eden plots from 200 sq yd at ₹99.9 lakh onwards; Golf Drive farmhouse plots from 1,300 sq yd at ₹2.99 Cr onwards; Acqua Front Villas from 390 sq yd at ₹3.59 Cr onwards; and studio, 1 BHK and 2 BHK apartments from ₹11,490 per sq ft. A separate sales message quotes plots from ₹1.35 Cr and villas from ₹3.50 Cr, so ask for the current price sheet.

faqs.question: What is the rental commitment on Acqua Front Villas?
faqs.answer: The brochure lists a 15-year lease at ₹1,75,000 per month, locked for the first 3 years, then 85% of profit shared with the owner. It also lists lifetime Wyndham membership, 5 years of golf course membership and a 30-day free stay each year. These are contractual promises by the developer and operator, so read the lease deed before relying on them.

faqs.question: Who designs and manages the township?
faqs.answer: The golf course is designed by IDG (UK). The developer says the township will be managed by a five-star hospitality partner, and the Acqua Front Villas by The Registry Collection by Wyndham.

faqs.question: Is bank finance available?
faqs.answer: The developer states that bank loans are available. Confirm which lenders have approved the specific phase.

content.investmentCommentary:
Falcon's read: Golf City is a long-horizon land and leisure play. The upside depends on Mopa airport's growth, the proposed Shakti Peeth Expressway and how quickly the golf course and resort amenities are delivered.

On the stated villa rent: ₹1,75,000 a month is ₹21 lakh a year, about 5.9% gross on a ₹3.59 Cr entry price, before costs and tax. That is well above typical Indian residential yields, which is exactly why the lease terms, the operator's obligations and what happens after year 3 need to be read in the contract.

The brochure's appreciation chart projects land rates rising to ₹1,00,000+ per sq yd by 2030. That is a developer projection, not a market index.

diligenceNotes.label: Location and jurisdiction
diligenceNotes.detail: Marketed as Goa, but the developer's plan sheets and map place the site at Banda, across the border in Sindhudurg, Maharashtra. Stamp duty, land-use rules and the RERA authority follow the state the land is actually in. Confirm survey numbers and the state before booking.

diligenceNotes.label: Rental commitment
diligenceNotes.detail: The ₹1.75 L/month villa rent is a developer and operator promise, not a guarantee in law. Read the lease deed and the operator agreement with The Registry Collection by Wyndham.

diligenceNotes.label: Township vs phase
diligenceNotes.detail: The 500+ acre township and golf course are described as proposed. Only the Garden of Eden phase shows a RERA number. Buy against the registered phase, not the township master plan.
